# Public Records (publicrecordsmusic.com)

> Independent artist management and records company in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Home of melodic underground rap artist MASTO.
> Last updated: 2026-09-15. Press / playlists / radio / bookings: stephanie@publicrecordsmusic.com. Management: management@publicrecordsmusic.com.

## MASTO — facts

- Name: MASTO (stylized in caps). Melodic underground rap / hip-hop. Based in South Minneapolis, Minnesota, US.
- Background: born in Minneapolis to a Dutch mother and a Cameroonian father.
- Self-contained: writes, records, mixes, and films his own music and videos.
- Label / management: Public Records (Minneapolis).
- Official profiles: Spotify https://open.spotify.com/artist/5aFbadR0TINJ22xzCR995P · TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@mastoforever · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mastoforever · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@mastoforever
- Audience (as of 2026-09-15): CLOSER 300,000+ streams on Spotify; TikTok @mastoforever 25,200 followers / 2,000,000 likes; Instagram 2,747 followers.
- Influences: Lil Tecca (cited as his biggest influence). Sound sits alongside Rich Amiri and Yung Fazo.
- Circle: rappers KDNG and Preesh Always, producer Gavin Stacey, and Shiv (produced CLOSER).

## Releases

- HABITS — single, released 2026-08-07. https://open.spotify.com/track/6uY1zMQno9PgSPWn24zNTv
- FOREVER — EP, 6 tracks, released June 2026 (TOO LONG, SHE GO, OKAY OKAY, JET LAG, BACK TO YA, USED 2 THIS). https://open.spotify.com/album/6I8aQ0nkyab4V0IhJdP9HE
- CLOSER — single, released 2025-11-10; 300,000+ Spotify streams, no paid promotion. https://open.spotify.com/track/4eFwsF6emaefRcEa4iGQ5o
- Earlier singles: ALIVE, SOTA!, James Bond.

## September 2026 — New York

- MASTO was in New York for Fashion Week, September 9–12, 2026 (fittings with independent brands, shoots with street photographers, studio time).
- He was seen at Engine Room Audio, 42 Broadway (22nd floor), Manhattan — a recording, mixing and mastering studio founded in 1996 by Mark B. Christensen. Credits include SZA's Ctrl (recorded and mastered there), Pop Smoke, Raekwon, Kay Flock, and 41. A plaque for Lil Tecca's "Ransom" hangs in the studio.
- Sessions in New York with the artist Gr!m.
- MASTO has recorded music with vax (West Palm Beach rapper-producer; Blue Dawn album 2026-04-24, B4VXN EP 2026-09-08). Nothing from those sessions is announced yet.
- Rumor: an On The Radar (Gabe P's New York freestyle platform) appearance. UNCONFIRMED — neither MASTO nor Public Records has confirmed it.
